articles.title: Meet China’s giant Jiutian drone: 6-tonne payload, 12-hour endurance and a swarm-carrying design; how powerful is Beijing’s flying mothership?
articles.description: China has flown its large, jet-powered Jiutian drone for the first time. The aircraft is much bigger than many military drones in service today. Its size also gives it room to carry a heavy payload, including equipment designed to release swarms of smaller drones. Built by AVIC, the jet-powered aircraft can carry up to six tonnes and stay airborne for 12 hours. The drone can reportedly reach speeds of up to 378 knots and operate at altitudes of up to 15,000 metres.

Flagships And Foldables The Galaxy S25 Ultra is listed at Rs 89,999 against an earlier price of Rs 1,29,999, and Amazon advertises an effective Rs 84,999 after a coupon and bank offer. It has a 6.9-inch QHD+ 120Hz display, a 200MP main camera, a built-in S Pen and a 5,000mAh battery. The Galaxy S26 is at Rs 89,999, the S26 Plus at Rs 1,14,999 and the S26 Ultra at Rs 1,24,999, which adds a Privacy Display. The Galaxy Z Fold 7 is listed at Rs 1,29,999, down from Rs 2,04,999. Check The Final Price Before You Order Prices differ between reports and can change as the sale runs, so open the product page and check the final payable amount, including any coupon. Amazon has confirmed a 10 per cent instant discount on eligible SBI credit and debit cards, and Prime members can get up to 10 per cent extra benefits, though caps and minimum order values apply. Confirm the exact variant, storage and colour, and the return window. You can browse Samsung mobile phones on Amazon and compare your shortlist before you buy.
